description: goPartyGiggles.com — dance-along, sing-along music for ages 6 and up. Party Giggles from the JubileePraise collection.
audience: Ages 6 and up. The older half of the children's catalogue.

seo.titleDefault: goPartyGiggles.com — Big Songs for Big Kids
seo.canonicalNote: Derived from hosts[0], because NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL is a single process-wide value and belongs to JubileePraise.

catalogue.scopeEnforcedAt: app/web/lib/manifest.ts load() — a filtered copy, so another tenant's album is unreachable by direct URL, not merely hidden
catalogue.musicDriveNote: The PER-DOMAIN root, which is what deploy/rebuild-manifest.mjs and deploy/check-manifest.mjs scan (EXTRA_ROOTS). Masters were re-filed here on 2026-08-16.
catalogue.staleCopyNote: ⚠ A FULL SECOND COPY, identical album list and identical file timestamps, still sitting at the pre-2026-08-16 location. It is not a junction — J: is a network share, so a link was impossible — and nothing scans it. Measured 2026-08-17. Editing the wrong one is silent: the manifest will not see the change and the site will not move.

home.featuredNote: TenantHome pins nothing. It shows one row per artist, everything the tenant has.

navNote: No /inspire, /children, /general or /christmas: those browse surfaces are empty under this scope. nav.upgrade is filtered out for a paid signed-in visitor, in components/Header.tsx.

production.apexBehaviour: served directly; apex and www share one server block
production.originTlsNote: ⚠ PORT 80 ONLY. This vhost has no listen 443 and no ssl_certificate, so HTTPS works purely because Cloudflare terminates it at the edge and reaches the origin over plain HTTP. jubileepraise.com has a Cloudflare origin certificate; these two do not.

runtime.devNote: localhost resolves to JubileePraise, not here. To see this tenant locally, send the Host header or add a hosts-file entry.

env.shared: all four NEXT_PUBLIC_* vars are process-wide; there is no per-tenant env

deploy.note: One pm2 process serves all three hosts, so a deploy ships them together. This site cannot be shipped on its own.

studio.voiceNote: The label folder IS the voice in the studio, which is why studioMusicRoot is the parent of musicDrive.

notes: The manifest category key is `party-giggles`; on the music drive it lives one level deeper, under children/. The two are not the same string and nothing should assume they are.
A code prefix is not a tenant boundary. The catalogue scope is the category key, enforced in lib/manifest.ts at load.
